publication_metadata.title: Intermediate-area cylinders in the principal quadratic stratum
publication_metadata.description: We derive a Poisson limit for intermediate cylinder areas in the principal holomorphic quadratic stratum Q(1^(4g-4)), with the square-count cutoff tending to infinity before the genus. For every s_g tending to zero with g s_g tending to infinity, normalized cylinder areas divided by s_g converge to a Poisson point process of intensity dx/(2x). Compact-window counts converge jointly with every fixed joint moment. The count in Delecroix's original window [1/sqrt(g),2/sqrt(g)] tends to Poisson(log(2)/2), and its mean and variance tend to log(2)/2. The proof extracts a uniform Gamma/Dirichlet comparison from the published geometric formulas of Delecroix-Liu and Delecroix-Goujard-Zograf-Zorich, with the underlying intersection-number estimates credited to Aggarwal. The exact weighted permutation model and the classical Arratia-Barbour-Tavare and Arratia-Tavare probability inputs are prior work. This is a geometric moving-window consequence, not a new model or enumeration. Earlier Delecroix-Liu microscopic announcements, Liu's thesis and later primitive slides are acknowledged. A complete public Small components manuscript was not located in the bounded priority audit; unavailable contents remain a priority uncertainty, and no universal first-priority claim is made. The separate OWR microscopic multiplier 4g-4 is not identified with the exact Gamma total 6g-6; no new microscopic theorem is asserted. Other strata, diagonal square-count/genus sampling and simultaneous directional laws are outside scope. The deposit includes a seven-page note and a source/verification archive with 7,100 exact assertions, 46,233 labelled permutations and 123 low-genus DVV composition cases, plus source hashes and authored audits. Finite controls do not replace the analytic proof or certify the imported geometry. AI tools were used extensively in development, derivation, computation, literature research, writing and independent internal adversarial checking. This is an unrefereed preprint without external human peer review or proof-assistant formalization.
